K7S2: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I live.
I live by continually seeing the sight of the Guru.
22P7: I wash the Guru's Feet, and drink in this water. ||1||
The Guru's feet I continually wash and drink that wash.
3X7W: I take my daily bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.
In the dust of Guru's feet, I daily take bath.
U3FL: The egotistical filth of countless incarnations is washed off. ||2||
Like this I have washed off filth of ego of many births.
6L5T: I wave the fan over the Guru.
I wave the fan over that Guru.
PMVG: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me from the great fire. ||3||
Giving his hand, he has saved me from the great fire.
83DG: I carry water for the Guru's household;
I fetch water for the house of that Guru,
6TBC: from the Guru, I have learned the Way of the One Lord. ||4||
from whom (Guru) I have learnt the way of knowledge.
6BC7: I grind the corn for the Guru's household.
I, for ever, grind corn for the house of that Guru,
AD9K: By His Grace, all my enemies have become friends. ||5||
by whose grace, all my enemies, have become friends.

MT0V: The Guru who gave me my soul,
That Guru, who gave me life,
LG1E: has Himself purchased me, and made me His slave. ||6||
has himself purchased me and made me his slave.
AXPP: He Himself has blessed me with His Love.
On his own, he has blest me with his affection.
JKBN: Forever and ever, I humbly bow to the Guru. ||7||
For ever and ever, I make obeisance to that Guru.
Q4Q8: My troubles, conflicts, fears, doubts and pains have been dispelled;
My hankering, strife, dread, doubt and discomfort, have ended.
FWC1: says Nanak, my Guru is All-powerful. ||8||9||
Says Nanak, so powerful is my Guru.
NW68: Meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. Please bless me with Your Name.
Meet me O my World-Lord, bestow on me Your name.
6G64: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, cursed, cursed is love and intimacy. ||1||Pause||
Blasted and blighted is the love which is without the Name. Pause.
V12X: Without the Naam, one who dresses and eats well
Without God's Name, he, who wears and eats,
FQM8: is like a dog, who falls in and eats impure foods. ||1||
is like a dog, who falls in (on) impure leaf plates.
6LXE: Without the Naam, all occupations are useless,
Without the Name the entire business is futile,
4HRB: Like decorations on a dead body. ||2||
like the decoration of a corpse.
6L0R: One who forgets the Naam and indulges in pleasures,
Forgetting the Name, he, who indulges in revelments,
WECU: shall find no peace, even in dreams; his body shall become diseased. ||3||
has no peace even in dream and his body becomes diseased.
JKLQ: One who renounces the Naam and engages in other occupations,
Abandoning Lord's Name, if man engages in other occupations,
A89Y: shall see all of his false pretenses fall away. ||4||
the whole of his false gilding would fall off.
0R53: One whose mind does not embrace love for the Naam
The man, who embraces not affection for the Name,
9FKK: shall go to hell, even though he may perform millions of ceremonial rituals. ||5||
goes to hell even though he perform millions of ceremonial rites.
1UW0: One whose mind does not contemplate the Name of the Lord
He who remembers not God's Name in his heart,
1JMW: is bound like a thief, in the City of Death. ||6||
is bound like a thief, in the city of death.
1VBC: Hundreds of thousands of ostentatious shows and great expanses
Lacs of ostentaions and great extensions,
ZTNL: - without the Naam, all these displays are false. ||7||
Without God's Name, false are the displays.
XZJW: That humble being repeats the Name of the Lord,
That man alone repeats God's Name, to whom,
GW5T: O Nanak, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy. ||8||10||
O Nanak, he mercifully grants this.
FV0Y: My mind longs for that Friend,
One who stands by me in the beginning, middle and the end,
DTJD: Who shall stand by me in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. ||1||
my soul longs for that Friend.
RBH8: The Lord's Love goes with us forever.
God's love, ever goes with the mortal.
DTMZ: The Perfect and Merciful Lord cherishes all. ||1||Pause||
The Omnipresent and Merciful Master cherishes all. Pause.
GSME: He shall never perish, and He shall never abandon me.
The Lord perishes not, and leaving his servant goes no where.
TSY2: Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading and permeating. ||2||
Wherever I gaze, there is He contained.
VPHW: He is Beautiful, All-knowing, the most Clever, the Giver of life.
The Lord is Beautiful, Skilful, Sharp-willed and the Giver of life.
PHF2: God is my Brother, Son, Father and Mother. ||3||
The Master is my brother, son, father and mother.
X1Q5: He is the Support of the breath of life; He is my Wealth.
He is the support of my life and soul He is my capital.
AMJP: Abiding within my heart, He inspires me to enshrine love for Him. ||4||
Abiding within my mind, the Lord has caused me to enshrine love for Him.
5M22: The Lord of the World has cut away the noose of Maya.
The World-cherisher has cut off my halter of mammon.
Q625: He has made me His own, blessing me with His Glance of Grace. ||5||
Beholding me with a gracious glance, he has make me His own.
LX7X: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, all diseases are healed.
By continually remembering Him, all the diseases are healed.
X7G1: Meditating on His Feet, all comforts are enjoyed. ||6||
Fixing attention on his feet all the comforts are enjoyed.
ARWR: The Perfect Primal Lord is Ever-fresh and Ever-young.
The Omnipresent Lord is ever fresh and ever youthful.
UK7A: The Lord is with me, inwardly and outwardly, as my Protector. ||7||
Within and without, God is with me as my Protector.
193A: Says Nanak, that devotee who realizes the state of the Lord, Har, Har,
Says Nanak, one who realises Lord God's dignity,
YDL5: is blessed with the treasure of the Naam. ||8||11||
to that Saint He gives His Name as all the wealth.
GR61: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. By the True Guru's grace He is obtained.
Z418: Countless are those who wander around searching for You, but they do not find Your limits.
Myriads walk about searching You, O Lord, but they find not Your limits.
84X3: They alone are Your devotees, who are blessed by Your Grace. ||1||
They alone becomes Yours devotees on whom is Your grace.
DJ4K: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||
I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice, to You, my God. Pause.
3KD8: Continually hearing of the terrifying path, I am so afraid.
By hearing, and again hearing of the Frightful Path, I am terribly terrified.
NWZG: I have sought the Protection of the Saints; please, save me! ||2||
I have sought Saints' asylum, O God's favourite do you save me.
